two_distinct_causes.SUBSTANTIVE_MINIMUM_LENGTH_12: text_business_candidates._substantive requires at least twelve characters. Product names are shorter than that: Zantac is six, Chantix seven, Paxlovid and Asbestos eight, Docetaxel nine. defects.shared_root_cause: The page-furniture criterion identifies a running header by repetition: a block that repeats inside its scope next to another repeating block. Enphase writes its footer as one block that carries the page number, so every instance is a different text and no two can be compared. This is not the scope-coverage problem fixed in the same reading - widening that criterion to every scope removes Ford's eight running headers and, measured over all eleven saved periods, touches nothing else, including this block.

defects.why_it_was_not_repaired_at_first: Catching it needs a second criterion - repetition after the digits are removed, or something like it - and this corpus offers exactly one example of it. A rule written from one filing is the rule that fails on the seventh, which is the mistake this Issue has already made and recorded. It is registered so the coordinate stops counting as verified, and a positive case is what would justify writing the rule.
defects.why_it_was_repaired_after_all: The rule asks for more than the one example shows: the text before the page number must recur on at least three pages and sit beside a neighbour that recurs too. Over the eleven saved D02 filings it removes this block and no other, and no D03 set moves.

defects.summary: Published 0. Pfizer's 8-K of 2025-11-13 (0000078003-25-000159) carries only item 8.01, headed 'Results of Other Events', and reports that Pfizer 'completed the previously announced acquisition of Metsera, Inc. ... pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger'. The approved definition counts an 8.01 once a keyword in its text confirms it ('8.01 需正文关键词确认'); 'acquisition' and 'merger' are both in the item. Under every reading of that confirmation - literal in the item, literal anywhere in the document, or the item reporting a transaction - the count is 1.
defects.root_cause: deterministic_router.match_event_claims tests the aliases against the claim's 'brief'. adapt_8k_item_index sets that brief to '8-K item <code> parsed from hdr.sgml' whenever the filing's hdr.sgml carries item codes, and the primary-document heading only when it does not; catalog/event_routes.json puts HDR_SGML_ITEM_CODE first. Every filing in the seven windows has hdr item codes, so the 8.01 branch compares the aliases with a constant string that contains none of them and admits nothing. The heading text is computed (primary_heading_brief) and never matched. The router's bytes are frozen by the issue_28 generations and shared with the ordinary route, which carries the same behaviour.
defects.scope_measured: Twenty-three item 8.01 filings in the seven windows that deliver E01, each read whole (content-acceptance/e01-eight-o-one-read.json). One reports a transaction the registrant is party to - this one. Four carry an alias inside the item and only this one of them reports a transaction; the other three are Marriott's use of proceeds ('may include ... acquisitions', twice) and Macy's tender offer ('a combined aggregate purchase price'). Four more carry one only in another item (Item 1.01 covenant text, Item 7.01 'repricing transaction').
defects.found_by: the E01 8.01 reading, which reads each item off the saved primary document instead of reproducing the route's text scoping. The first extraction missed this very filing: it looked for the heading 'Other Events' and Pfizer's reads 'Results of Other Events', so the item read as empty and carried no alias - the same shape as the route's miss, one layer up.
defects.why_not_repaired_yet: Pfizer's count is 1 under every reading, but any repair has to pick one, and the choice moves other positions: the literal reading in the item adds Marriott's two use-of-proceeds filings and Macy's tender offer, which are not M&A announcements. Which reading the definition means is the decision in e01-keyword-branch/decision.json.

defects.summary: Published 0.2295243829018663455749548465. The D&A it adds is DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization 1,200,000,000, which the filing tags in one sentence of its property and equipment note: 'Depreciation and amortization of fixed assets totaled $1.2 billion'. The filing's statement total, DepreciationAndAmortization 3,631,000,000, includes amortization of acquired intangibles - $692 million in cost of revenues and $995 million in sales and marketing - which the taken fact leaves out.
defects.root_cause: calculator._select_structured_fact takes the first approved concept that carries a candidate and never compares it with the later ones; B03's direct chain lists DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization first. A concept name is a clue, not proof of what a number covers, and here the filer uses the concept for a narrower quantity than the chain assumes.
defects.scope_measured: all nine B03 filings in this frame (b03-depreciation-scope/finding.json). This is the only one whose direct D&A candidates disagree; Lumen tags two direct concepts and they agree.
defects.found_by: the D&A-family census over each filing's own inline XBRL, run while re-reading the one B03 value the earlier cross-source reading had written up as 'the route is right and the reading cannot confirm it'. That record said the primary document does not tag DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization; it does.
defects.why_not_repaired_yet: the statement total cannot simply replace the subtotal: it also carries amortization and impairment of right-of-use assets, the definition says impairment is not added back, and the year's amount is not tagged separately. The recommended repair - withhold when direct D&A candidates disagree - changes the approved selection rule, so it goes through the revision mechanism. See b03-depreciation-scope/finding.json.

defects.root_cause: text_business_candidates.board_composition_candidates labels a block 'committee information' when it names any committee anywhere and contains any of the committee_structure words anywhere ('chair of', 'members of', 'committee chair', 'serves as', 'member of', ...). The two are not required to relate, nor to describe this board: a director-compensation line ('Audit Committee Chair Retainer'), an equity plan's administrator clause, a biography's other-company committee and the audit committee's auditor pre-approval all qualify. Across the ten judged values 87 of the 94 excerpts outside board composition carry the committee label. The selector's bytes are frozen by the issue_28 generations and shared with the ordinary route, which carries the same behaviour.
defects.scope_measured: Ten C02 values (nine newest periods and Paramount's predecessor FY2024), 246 excerpts judged one by one against the definition: 82 composition facts, 51 composition policies or processes, 19 committee or board functions, 94 outside board composition. Every value holds at least three of the last kind. Whether the selector also misses composition statements was not read.
defects.found_by: c02-board-read/excerpt-judgements.json, held to the route's own selection from the saved proxies by tools/read_c02_board_statements.py
defects.why_not_repaired_yet: A repair is a successor selector, and its target is partly a meaning question: whether the definition's 'committee information' includes committee functions (19 excerpts) and composition policies (51). What is outside under every reading (94) can be removed without that answer, but a rule that removes it has to be held to these judgements first - the same measurement the D02 keyword proxy needed, where the obvious narrowing lost more correct text than wrong. See c02-board-read/README.md.

defects.summary: Read in both directions against the predecessor's own 10-K (CIK 813828). Of the sixteen excerpts, fifteen are the Item 3 incorporation and the incorporated 'Legal Matters' caption of Note 19 (the transaction litigation, the Section 220 demands, the asbestos and environmental claims). Block 2010 is the 'Transaction-Related Items' paragraph of the corporate-matters note: what the transaction costs were, including the stockholder-litigation settlement amounts of 2022 and 2023. It is admitted because 'litigation' appears in it; it is not the legal-proceedings or contingencies disclosure the approved source names - the same judgement as the successor year's block 2108. The other direction found the italic matter labels 'Asbestos' (2877) and 'Other' (2885) dropped; that half is repaired (d02-content-read/italic-note-labels.json).
defects.root_cause: Same as D02_PARAMOUNT_2025_KEYWORD_PROXY_ADMITS_COST_AND_COVENANT_NOTES: the _LEGAL keyword standing in for 'is this a legal-proceedings disclosure' on Item 8 blocks outside the incorporated note.
defects.scope_measured: All sixteen excerpts and every untaken block inside Item 3 and the incorporated caption (d02-content-read/italic-note-labels.json census).
defects.found_by: a both-directions reading of the FY2024 set, derived from the saved filing through the route's own text input
defects.why_not_repaired_yet: The keyword proxy is the registered decision in d02-content-read/keyword-proxy-decision.json; this filing adds a sixth instance and no new criterion.

purpose: Results this repository has confirmed hold wrong content. An entry withdraws a result from current delivery. It does not delete it, re-sign it, or relabel it as a structural non-applicability: the original Run stays readable so the defect can be demonstrated and the repair checked.
release_rule: A coordinate-level entry stops withdrawing only when its 'released' block names the repaired result by result_id, and the Requirement closure it was produced under. repair_state is a note about the work; it releases nothing. An entry naming a result_id withdraws exactly that result and is never released.
